description: selfFactSpec rows (v1 as a committed data file) read at use time by development-vessel's self_fact_reconcile from the git object origin/dev:scripts/substrate/self-facts.json in each node's super-repo clone. A row registers one instrument (a fact function in self-fact-reconcile.ts): the node profiles whose node holds the copies it checks, the edit site its gaps point at, and its must-fail control. An instrument with no row does not run. REALIGNMENT 2026-09-29 §2.1 items 1, 3, 4, 5. Rows with instrument journal_pattern are recurring-defect detectors (unit, pattern, max, window_hours, must_fail_line, gate); the canary fires only if the pattern matches its own must_fail_line (REALIGNMENT 2026-09-29 section 7 step 2). Rows with instrument lookup_classification check that a failed discovery lookup is never read as no producer (a per-node journal count plus planted failed lookups); rows with instrument typed_seam_sites count discovery lookup sites outside the typed ias seam against a ratcheting ceiling (max), lowered by a data commit as sites migrate, and read unobserved when any clone ref is older than max_ref_age_hours.

rows.must_fail: canary: a planted gap with an overlapping retry, a stage-contradicting class and an unescalated repeat refusal, plus a planted source with one unbranched checkOpNoEffect call, must all be measured; controls every run: noEffectOverlapRefusal must refuse a planted retry re-editing a no-effect span (else enforcement-not-refusing) and allow a disjoint one (else enforcement-over-refusing); fewer than min_sites branched checkOpNoEffect call sites at origin/dev is divergence gate-call-sites; retries past apply with no recorded spans make the row UNOBSERVED; a planted journaled refusal with no stored record must be measured (canary), and journaled refusals exceeding stored refusals for an unsaturated gap is divergence refusals-not-recorded
rows.notes: FOLLOW-UP: once intervention 1 lands, fold this row's git-show call-site count into I1's countSites and gate it on refAgeHours (a stale origin/dev must read unobserved, never as a count). The journal cross-check reads only this node's development-vessel journal; node 2 (compute) composes are not cross-checked unless the row is also scoped to compute.

The pattern must also match its own must_fail_line.

rows.notes: autonomyScope is a trust root and the containment the autonomous lane obeys; an absent record reads closed, so drift is the remaining failure: one node's copy gaining or losing an excluded path, or its falsifier classes changing, while the other keeps the old value. Compared: excluded_paths and require_falsifier_classes as exact-string sets (a directory entry 'x/' and a file entry 'x' differ); the reason text is not compared. Node keys are thisNode(): SUBSTRATE_NAME when set (compose2-live sets compose2), else the node's volume-held vessel identity key, key-<12 hex of sha256(public key)>, which survives a container recreate (substrate-live sets no SUBSTRATE_NAME, so its key is key-595289e706e5). A node that holds the record but has no pinned value here is reported <node>-unpinned, never skipped. Rows naming nodes are skipped on every other node and substrate (nodes field). The pinned value is operator-authored here (a git object), never read from the pool it checks; changing the record means changing this row in the same operator act. THE OPENING ACT (2026-10-11, path (b) re-pin): both values are the live record after the operator edit, so they include the three tightening holds the evaluator placed 2026-10-09 (composer-interruption-sweep.ts, goal-target-inference.ts, write-shapes.test.ts; expiring 2026-10-12T00:08Z on node1, 00:18Z on compose2): their expiry is an evaluator change whose chain starts at this pinned set, so it is accepted. Both gain the gap-judge core and the files it trusts (the act's 45 closes, among them the core's directory entry repos/development-vessel/src/judge/, so a module added there later is excluded by prefix the moment it exists). The committed seed additionally lists the nine test/judge-split/*.test.ts files by name (pull-sync runs only file-named .test.ts entries alone); the directory entry already excludes them, so these values do not repeat them. Only node1's value omits repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/gap-to-feature.ts: the residue is open to the autonomous lane on node1 alone, while scripts/substrate/autonomy-scope.json (the fleet default) and compose2 keep it excluded. A later operator re-pin set both values to each node's live record after those tightening holds expired; it also carries the env-read ratchet closes (each vessel's test/ratchet/ and the super-repo ratchet files), which had been added to the record without updating this row. The drafter-split scope act (development-vessel design 5bc144dc; a LOOSENING approved by the user, relayed by qa) adds to both values repos/development-vessel/test/drafter-split/, its seven pin tests by name (pull-sync's protected gate runs a closed .test.ts alone only when it is named, as the judge split's pins are), and the four helpers on feature-compose's apply and refusal path (src/control-bytes.ts, src/cross-file-symbols.ts, src/edit-provenance.ts, src/resolvers/region-probe.ts); its opening of src/drafter/ and test/drafter/ removes nothing, since neither value excluded them. A later tighten-only close adds goal-host's write-goal judge rules and their test (src/write-goal-artifact.ts, test/write-goal-artifact.test.ts), which the reach-judge fix created without a scope entry. Build 7 part 1 (judge and routing input capture) adds goal-host's closed src/judge/ and test/judge-capture/ (with its four tests by name) and development-vessel's test/judge-capture/ (with its three tests by name); the evaluator's own tightening holds stay out of these values and are accepted as evaluator changes. A tighten-only act closes the judge push's new trust files and protected tests (goal-host's walk-egress guard, its vendored list manifest and test, the corpus-runner identity test; development-vessel's arming-only-landing test) and the deployment series' pins of the per-vessel key restore and the corpus-runner key's scoping and minting (three validation/scripts tests): each lands with its scope entry before the code. The node1-only opening of repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/gap-to-feature.ts (10-11 opening residue: lane authoring on node1, landings judged by every node's gate) is reviewed 2026-10-17 with the build-7 opening: has node1's lane edited it, and did those edits hold.
